meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会按任务动态组建由执行、指挥、评审三类角色组成的智能体团队,实时展示它们讨论、辩论与形成决策的过程,所有角色共享同一套上下文记忆,最后汇总输出方案、代码或会议记录。
howto.when: 当任务需要多个智能体协同完成,或需要管理特定场景的智能体组合时触发,例如技术架构决策会议、OPC 系统构建、产品定价策略会议等。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构方案
say.note: 可看到主持人引导发言、辩论与共识收敛

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 输出战略分析、产品架构与MVP代码

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场、财务、评审角色依次给出意见

howto.what_en: Claude assembles a task-specific agent team with execution, management, and review roles, shows their discussion and decisions in real time, shares one context memory across roles, and returns a combined plan, code, or meeting record.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs multiple agents working together, or you want to manage an agent set for a specific scenario — e.g. a tech architecture decision meeting, OPC system building, product pricing, etc.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate a microservices architecture.
say_en.note: See the host-led debate and final consensus.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for the AI short-video field.
say_en.note: Get strategy, product blueprint, and MVP code.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set the pricing strategy for this product.
say_en.note: Market, finance, and reviewer agents speak in turn.
